Source: [pkg/graph/doc.go](https://github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/blob/main/pkg/graph/doc.go).

Package graph defines AgentShield's provider-neutral graph model and the pure compiler that turns plugin assertions into a canonical snapshot.

## Pipeline position {#hdr-Pipeline_position}

Discovery plugins and the telemetry rollup emit an [Input](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/graph#Input): resource, facet, relationship, and bounded telemetry assertions. Package state persists those assertions per contribution and calls [Compiler](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/graph#Compiler) twice: once to validate a candidate contribution ([Compiler.CompileContribution](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/graph#Compiler.CompileContribution)) and once to materialize the union of all active contributions ([Compiler.Compile](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/graph#Compiler.Compile)). The resulting [Snapshot](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/graph#Snapshot) feeds current-state projections, the graph API, and reasoning. This package performs no I/O and holds no contribution or generation state; ownership and replacement live in package state.

## Identity {#hdr-Identity}

Every graph node is named by an [IdentityClaim](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/graph#IdentityClaim): a scheme (group, version, kind), an authority ID, and an immutable key. A [Registry](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/graph#Registry) maps each [IdentityScheme](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/graph#IdentityScheme) to a normalizer, and the compiler derives a UUIDv5 resource ID from the normalized tuple. Claims must be authority-qualified (a cluster UID or cloud account, not a plugin ID) and provider-immutable (an object UID or immutable resource name, not a display name, label, or IP address), so independent plugins converge on the same node and a recreated object gets a new one. Mutable values belong in attributes. NetworkDestination and NetworkPeerClass are built-in provider-neutral schemes preloaded by [NewRegistry](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/graph#NewRegistry); plugins register only the authority-specific schemes they introduce.

## Assertions and provenance {#hdr-Assertions_and_provenance}

Every assertion carries PluginID, SourceID, RuleID, and EvidenceIDs. The compiler rejects assertions without a plugin, source, or rule, sorts and deduplicates evidence IDs, groups equal claims onto one record while keeping every contributing assertion, deduplicates identical assertions, and sorts all output. Two inputs containing the same assertion set therefore compile to byte-identical [Snapshot.CanonicalJSON](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/graph#Snapshot.CanonicalJSON) and the same [Snapshot.Hash](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/graph#Snapshot.Hash), regardless of slice order or duplication.

Relationships use only predicates registered in this package (see [IsRegisteredPredicate](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/graph#IsRegisteredPredicate)); adding a predicate is a central change that must also update persistence constraints. A relationship or facet whose endpoint resource is not present is kept with [ResolutionUnresolved](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/graph#ResolutionUnresolved) so contributions can reference identities owned by other plugins without publication ordering. Conflicting kinds for one identity become an [AssertionConflict](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/graph#AssertionConflict) rather than an error.

## Security semantics {#hdr-Security_semantics}

[SecuritySemantics](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/graph#SecuritySemantics) is a closed, versioned, provider-neutral envelope stored in a facet attribute or relationship property under [SecuritySemanticsAttribute](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/agentshield-dev/agentshield/pkg/graph#SecuritySemanticsAttribute). The compiler validates every envelope present and requires canonical encoding; it does not enforce that one is present.

See docs/concepts/data-model.md for the full model.
